long_biography.plain_text:
Education-technology founder Alexander Grant Clark extended his work beyond software by co-founding Slate School, a nonprofit K–12 institution in North Haven. The school centres curiosity, creativity and nature-based learning on a 40-acre campus and conservancy, using its physical setting as part of the educational model.

Clark also serves as a Quinnipiac University trustee and received an honorary Doctor of Humane Letters for entrepreneurship and philanthropy. At Slate School, he and co-founder Jennifer Staple Clark worked with educators to establish a curiosity-driven curriculum. The result is a school designed to treat its natural setting as an active part of everyday learning.
